name: record_screen
description: Continuous high-speed screen recorder. Captures smooth desktop or window streams and compiles them into animated WebP or GIF videos with optional physical mouse cursor stamping.

action.description: Recorder action: 'start' initiates recording, 'stop' compiles and saves video file, 'status' reports telemetry, 'pause'/'resume' controls loop.

output_path.description: Destination file path for output video (e.g. 'assets/demo.webp' or 'assets/demo.gif'). Required when action is 'stop'.

fps.description: Capture frame rate (5 to 30 FPS). Default is 15 FPS.

target.description: Optional window title substring to scope recording strictly to that application window.

crop_region.description: Optional [x, y, w, h] pixel bounding box to record a specific region of interest.

max_dim.description: Maximum resolution dimension (e.g. 720, 800, 1080) for downscaling. Default 800px ensures compact filesize.

include_cursor.description: Whether to render a visible hardware mouse pointer arrow onto the frames.

format.description: Video animation format: 'webp' (24-bit truecolor high compression) or 'gif'.

max_duration.description: Safety timeout in seconds to auto-stop recording and prevent runaway memory usage.
